svg.title: Jobs within 60 minutes by public transport under a fare budget, by income quintile, Porto Alegre
svg.desc: Grouped bars, one group per income quintile, of the mean share of jobs reached within 60 minutes by public transport in the Porto Alegre sample at any fare, with at most two bus fares and with at most one. One bus fare, which pays a single ride, keeps 84% of the access at any fare, and two fares, which pay a transfer, 98%; by quintile, one fare keeps 74% in the poorest, 76% in the second, 81% in the third, 86% in the fourth, 89% in the richest.

g.text: Mean share of the sample's 337,921 jobs reached within 60 minutes by public transport, by income quintile
of the city (Censo 2010), Monday 13 May 2019, departures 14:00–14:59. Over the bars of one fare: the part
of the access at any fare that it keeps (84% for all residents; two fares keep 98%)
What a fare budget leaves of the jobs within an hour, Porto Alegre
